answers.reason: The student only takes part in the one place where their matters are decided and is not a member of central university bodies like the senate.
The budget planning round is a central body for university funds, not the specific place where a student's faculty matters are decided.
Appointment committees select candidates for professorships, which is not the designated place for student matters.
Students are represented in the faculty by the elected student representative, not by participating themselves.
Study commissions are faculty bodies where students are not listed as participants since student interests are handled by their elected representative.
The examination board decides on examination matters of individual students, but students do not sit as members on the board.
The internal research funding round is for faculty research grants and not for student participation.
Module revision working groups are for rewriting module descriptions, not for student membership.
Laboratory equipment procurement is handled within the faculty without student membership.
Orientation week planning is for new students, but students holding no office do not take part as planners.
